in_marathi.name: Rutika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rutika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'ruti', meaning 'contentment'. It is also believed to be derived from the word 'rutu', meaning 'season' or 'rut', meaning 'wheel'. The name signifies the turning of the wheel of life, symbolizing the constant flow of life and the idea of finding contentment in the present moment.
